description: This Java test class 'DeviceRegistrationAmqpIT' verifies the behavior of the Device Registry component's Device Registration AMQP endpoint. It sets up and tears down test environment, manages clients, and extends from a base test class.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationAmqpIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Device Registration via AMQP endpoint, extending base API tests.

methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up registry client and registration client factory.

methods.description: Cleans up the test environment after each test, deleting objects created.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the environment, disconnects registration client.

methods.description: Returns the helper instance for tests.
